item.title: For loop to perform paired t-test for each row in a tibble?
item.description:
Hello! I'm a beginner to R and stats, and I'm trying to perform a paired t-test (and also understand what I'm doing...). I've arranged my data looks like this, which I was told would be more compatible with performing t-tests:
https://preview.redd.it/rdm12gs4u62f1.png?width=1288&format=png&auto=webp&s=8d9a0328712a2846ed1cccb3bc096e9caa05762e
In English, I would say, "for each gene, perform a t-test comparing the means of strain1\_half\_lives and strain2\_half\_lives, and pair the values in each vector."
For example, in the first row, 0.8444763 would be paired with 0.7871189.
I will then do an FDR correction on the p-values.
Thank you so much!
